intro: Greek Vinaigrette at CAVA brings authentic Mediterranean flavors to your bowl or pita with its simple yet flavorful combination of extra virgin olive oil, red wine vinegar, and oregano. This classic dressing is included free with your meal (up to 2 dressings) and delivers 130 calories of pure Mediterranean taste. Explore the complete [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings) to find your perfect flavor match.
priceCalories: Greek Vinaigrette is included with your CAVA order at no additional cost when you select up to 2 dressings. At 130 calories per serving, it contains 14g of fat from heart-healthy olive oil, 1g of carbs, and 0g of protein. This calorie-conscious option fits well into various dietary plans while adding bold flavor to any creation from the [full CAVA menu](/).
whatMakesSpecial: What sets Greek Vinaigrette apart is its authentic Mediterranean simplicity. Made with premium extra virgin olive oil, tangy red wine vinegar, and aromatic oregano, this dressing captures the essence of Greek cuisine. Unlike heavier creamy dressings, it offers a light, herbaceous profile that enhances rather than overwhelms your ingredients. The quality olive oil base provides healthy monounsaturated fats that benefit heart health.
nutritionFacts: Greek Vinaigrette contains 130 calories per serving with 14g of fat, primarily from extra virgin olive oil. It has just 1g of carbohydrates and 0g of protein, making it suitable for low-carb and keto diets. The fat content comes from beneficial olive oil, rich in antioxidants and anti-inflammatory compounds. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) for detailed macros when building your custom bowl.
whatsInside: This traditional vinaigrette contains three simple ingredients: extra virgin olive oil as the base, red wine vinegar for tanginess, and oregano for aromatic herbal notes. The extra virgin olive oil provides richness and healthy fats, while red wine vinegar adds bright acidity. Dried oregano delivers that quintessential Greek flavor profile without artificial additives or preservatives.
tasteLike: Greek Vinaigrette offers a bright, tangy flavor with herbaceous oregano notes and a smooth olive oil finish. The red wine vinegar provides sharp acidity that cuts through rich proteins and creamy spreads, while the oregano adds earthy, slightly peppery undertones. The extra virgin olive oil creates a silky texture that coats ingredients without being heavy, delivering balanced Mediterranean flavor in every bite.
customize: Greek Vinaigrette pairs beautifully with items from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) like SuperGreens or Romaine. Try it over bowls featuring grilled chicken or falafel from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains). Combine it with Tzatziki or Hummus from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) for layered Mediterranean flavors. Add tomatoes, cucumbers, and red onion for a classic Greek salad experience.
pairsWell: This vinaigrette complements Garlic Dressing and Lemon Herb Tahini when you want to mix dressings. It enhances grilled proteins, fresh vegetables, and grain bases perfectly. Pair it with feta cheese, Kalamata olives, and chickpeas for authentic Greek flavors. The bright acidity balances rich items like avocado or creamy spreads, making it versatile across the entire CAVA menu.
healthyChoice: Greek Vinaigrette is an excellent healthy choice, featuring heart-healthy extra virgin olive oil rich in monounsaturated fats and antioxidants. With only 1g of carbs and no protein, it works for keto, low-carb, and Mediterranean diets. The simple, natural ingredients contain no artificial preservatives or added sugars. Visit the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for specific dietary information and restrictions.
howToOrder: When building your bowl or pita at CAVA, select Greek Vinaigrette from the dressings section. You can choose up to 2 dressings at no extra charge, so consider pairing it with another option. Request it on the side if you prefer controlling the amount. Order in-store, online, or through the app at any [CAVA Locations](/locations) near you for consistent quality and flavor.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Garlic Dressing at 180 calories, Greek Vinaigrette offers 50 fewer calories while maintaining bold flavor. Hot Harissa Vinaigrette and Lemon Herb Tahini both contain 70 calories, making them lighter options if you want fewer calories. However, Greek Vinaigrette provides the most authentic traditional Mediterranean taste profile with its oregano-infused olive oil base and classic red wine vinegar tang.
whoShouldTry: Greek Vinaigrette is perfect for Mediterranean food lovers seeking authentic flavors and anyone following low-carb or keto diets. Health-conscious diners appreciate its simple, clean ingredients and heart-healthy olive oil. Those who prefer lighter, oil-based dressings over creamy options will enjoy its bright acidity. If you love traditional Greek salads or herb-forward flavors, this dressing is essential for your CAVA bowl.
worthTrying: Greek Vinaigrette is absolutely worth trying for its authentic Mediterranean taste and nutritional benefits. The combination of quality extra virgin olive oil, red wine vinegar, and oregano creates a classic flavor that elevates any bowl. Since it is included free with your order, there is no risk in trying it. Its versatility and health benefits make it a smart choice for regular CAVA visitors.
